t: What a person will be under on that Day
a: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
p: Alladhīna yunfiqūna amwālahum bi-l-layli wa-n-nahāri sirran wa ʿalāniyatan fa-lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim…
m: Those who spend their wealth [in Allāh's way] by night and by day, secretly and publicly - they will have their reward with their Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
